member.name: T:officera_API.Controllers.AuthController
member.summary: Sign-in (password / mobile OTP), registration, password reset and session endpoints. Login returns a JWT: send it as "Authorization: Bearer {token}".

member.name: M:officera_API.Controllers.AuthController.Login(officera.BusinessAccessLayer.DTOs.LoginRequest)
member.summary: Email + password sign-in. 5 failed attempts lock the account (Settings › Business rules).

member.name: M:officera_API.Controllers.AuthController.LoginWithOtp(officera.BusinessAccessLayer.DTOs.OtpLoginRequest)
member.summary: Sign-in with a mobile OTP (request it first with SendOtp, purpose LOGIN).

member.name: M:officera_API.Controllers.AuthController.SendOtp(officera.BusinessAccessLayer.DTOs.SendOtpRequest)
member.summary: Sends a one-time code. Purpose: LOGIN, REGISTER, ENQUIRY (mobile) or RESET (account email).

member.name: M:officera_API.Controllers.AuthController.VerifyOtp(officera.BusinessAccessLayer.DTOs.VerifyOtpRequest)
member.summary: Checks a code and returns a single-use verification id for Register / ResetPassword / Lead capture.

member.name: M:officera_API.Controllers.AuthController.Me
member.summary: The signed-in user and their current permissions (read from the database, not the token).

member.name: M:officera_API.Controllers.AuthController.CreateMemberLogin(officera.BusinessAccessLayer.DTOs.CreateMemberLoginRequest)
member.summary: Creates a member login (e.g. after lead conversion) with a one-time temporary password.

member.name: M:officera_API.Controllers.AuthController.Unlock(officera.BusinessAccessLayer.DTOs.UnlockUserRequest)
member.summary: Clears a sign-in lockout (Administration › Users).

member.name: T:officera_API.Controllers.CrudControllerBase`1
member.summary: Standard POST endpoints for a signed-in module: POST api/{Module}/Get · GetById · Save · Update · Delete. Fine-grained rules (permission matrix, location scope, member ownership) are enforced in the business layer.

member.name: M:officera_API.Controllers.CrudControllerBase`1.Get(officera.Shared.Common.PagedRequest)
member.summary: Search / filter / sort / paginate. PageSize 0 returns every row you may see.

member.name: T:officera_API.Controllers.PublicReadCrudControllerBase`1
member.summary: Same endpoints, but Get / GetById are open to the public website (the business layer limits anonymous callers to published / active rows). Save / Update / Delete still require a signed-in user.

member.name: T:officera_API.Controllers.LocationController
member.summary: Locations – Workspace › Locations, public search and location pages.

member.name: T:officera_API.Controllers.ResourceController

member.name: T:officera_API.Controllers.GalleryController

member.name: M:officera_API.Controllers.IntegrationController.Test(officera.Shared.Common.IdRequest)

member.name: T:officera_API.Controllers.RoleController

member.name: M:officera_API.Controllers.LookupController.GetStates

member.summary: Operator dashboard KPIs and charts calculated from the database.

member.name: T:officera_API.Controllers.IdsController
member.summary: Reserves human-readable ids (BKG-0042 ...) so the app can show a new record immediately while it is saved.

member.name: T:officera_API.Controllers.FileController
member.summary: File uploads (multipart/form-data). Files are validated (extension, size, signature), renamed and stored under wwwroot/uploads/{category}. The response carries the URL path to use in the app.

member.name: T:officera_API.Infrastructure.CurrentUserService
member.summary: Resolves the caller from the validated JWT, then loads role, locations, permissions and status from the database once per request. A deactivated or deleted account is treated as signed out immediately.

member.name: T:officera_API.Infrastructure.HttpContextAuditUserProvider
member.summary: Audit-column user id taken straight from the token (no database access, so it is safe inside DbContext setup).

member.name: T:officera_API.Infrastructure.ExceptionHandlingMiddleware
member.summary: Central error handling: every exception becomes the standard ApiResponse envelope. Business errors keep their message; unexpected errors are logged in full (Serilog) and the client only sees a generic message and a trace id.

member.name: T:officera_API.Infrastructure.ServiceRegistration
member.summary: Dependency-injection and pipeline setup, kept out of Program.cs.
